mapping.method: Per-site first-frame relative displacement and world orientation delta, anchored to authored Taku FK home.

home_selection.rule: auto: choose authored arms-down home if mean initial wrist height is >0.50 m below source chest; otherwise bent-elbow home. Explicit first-pose heuristic, not learned calibration.

mapping.source_skeleton: Unmodified aligned human world positions; distinct from robot-space retarget targets.
mapping.chest: torso_body_link origin and orientation; not a shoulder midpoint or an added translation
mapping.elbows: Position-only at left/right_elbow_link origins; mesh heading may be derived only for display.

solver.method: Offline warm-started weighted damped position IK, Gauss-Newton with active numerical bounds, trust-region step and FK merit backtracking.
solver.frame_trust_notice: Fixed numerical per-export-frame configuration jump guard: base x/y <=0.06 m; angular <=0.20 rad (folding/pitch <=0.15). This also bounds apparent playback speed at the sample rate; it is NOT a manufacturer actuator speed/acceleration specification and is not dt-scaled.
solver.bounds_notice: Public kinematics lacks manufacturer limits. These are experiment-defined numeric pose bounds, not validated hardware-safe limits.
solver.fixed_joints: Head, grippers and wheel joints stay at zero reference; mobile base is holonomic planar x/y/yaw, not wheel control.
solver.metric_sampling: Original excerpt timestamps (~30 Hz decimated from ~240 Hz); only valid target samples, no display-interpolated error samples.
